about: A withdrawal is the object's act: each claim key is a cell (cell from @lapxo/obligations/views/field) whose lines are the claims their signers observed there; each withdraw is observe(c, { takes: id }, −1) for every line whose fields hold the withdraw's own, the wire's naming; and what stands is live(c.seen), which 0.3.4 exports. What stands is what stood before, line for line; bound's own reading of withdrawal is gone from the verdict path.
